types.name: BANK_ACCOUNT
types.definition: A Norwegian or foreign bank account/loan account number identifying where money is held or owed.
include: Kontonummer value, 11 digits grouped 4.4.3 (`1234.56.78903`) or solid
Lånenummer / loan-account number under a bank field
Account number stated inline with a creditor name ("konto hos DNB, 1234.56.78903")
exclude: Org.nr./fødselsnummer-shaped digit strings under a government-identifier label (GOV_ID instead)
A bare NOK amount with no account number (that is FINANCIAL_INFO's own amount case, not this one)
types.boundary: Tag the account number exactly as printed, including group separators; extend to include a directly-attached creditor/bank name per FINANCIAL_INFO's own full-clause rule (ANNOTATION_SPEC §FINANCIAL_INFO boundary rule).

types.name: CASE_NUMBER
types.definition: A police, court, or agency case/reference number (saksnummer, sak nr., Vår ref/Deres ref when populated).
include: `Vår ref:` / `Deres ref:` when populated with an actual value
exclude: `Referanse: NNNNNN` — the agency's own complaint-intake routing number, left untagged by the spec in 98.6% of cases
A bare year or date with no case-number suffix (DATE_TIME instead)
types.boundary: Tag the full compound string including any attached court/authority name per B23; never split the date-shaped prefix off as DATE_TIME per B13's identifier carve-out.

types.name: CREDIT_CARD
types.definition: A payment card number (typically 16 digits, sometimes grouped in 4s) or its expiry/CVV when directly attached.
include: 16-digit PAN, grouped or solid
PAN with directly attached expiry date
exclude: A bare NOK amount charged to the card (tag the amount as its own FINANCIAL_INFO span if present, per that type's own boundary rule)
types.boundary: Tag the digit string exactly as printed; a directly-attached expiry/CVV stays in the same span per FINANCIAL_INFO's full-clause rule.

types.name: CRYPTO
types.definition: A cryptocurrency wallet address or exchange account identifier tied to a named person.
include: Wallet address string (e.g. a bech32/base58 string) under a "Lommebok"/"Krypto" label
Exchange account/reference number for a named crypto holding
exclude: A bare currency/amount figure with no address (that is FINANCIAL_INFO's own amount case)
types.boundary: Tag the address/identifier string alone; extend only to a directly-attached amount or exchange name per FINANCIAL_INFO's full-clause rule.

types.name: DATE_OF_BIRTH
types.definition: An explicit calendar date stated as a person's birth date, standalone or as the parenthetical of a fødselsnummer/name ("f. 12.05.1972").
include: `12.05.1972` after "f." or "Født:"
A birth date embedded as the parenthetical of a named person per B4
exclude: The fødselsnummer itself, even though its first 6 digits encode the same date — GOV_ID owns the whole number, never split off as DATE_TIME (mirrors the DATE_TIME×GOV_ID exclusivity rule)
types.boundary: Tag the date exactly as printed; per B4 a birth-date parenthetical attached to a named person is NOT absorbed into that person's span — it stays its own DATE_TIME span.

types.name: DEVICE_ID
types.definition: A hardware/device identifier (IMEI, MAC address, serial number of a personal device) tied to a named person.
include: IMEI number under a "Enhet:"/"IMEI:" label
MAC address, serial number of a phone/laptop/collar-tracker
exclude: A government-issued device registration (e.g. a firearms card number) — GOV_ID's own domain per B20
types.boundary: Tag the identifier string alone, stopping at the field label or following punctuation.

types.name: DRIVER_LICENSE
types.definition: A driver's licence number (Førerkortnummer), a public-authority-issued identifier per B20.
include: `Førerkortnummer: 12345678901`
exclude: A private vehicle-manufacturer serial number on the car itself
types.boundary: Tag the value exactly as printed after the Førerkortnummer label; issuer test (B20) puts it in GOV_ID because a public authority (Statens vegvesen/politiet) issues it.

types.name: EMAIL
types.definition: A complete local-part@domain email address.
include: Standard address after an "E-post:" label
Norwegian-letter local parts printed verbatim
exclude: Any string without an `@` sign
A redaction placeholder following a non-email field label
types.boundary: Tag the full local-part@domain string only, per EMAIL_ADDRESS's own boundary rule.

types.name: FAX_NUMBER
types.definition: A fax number under a "Faks:"/"Fax:" label.
include: Digit string, grouped or solid, immediately after a Faks/Fax label
exclude: The same digit shape under a "Telefon:" label — that is NO_PHONE_NUMBER instead, by field-label authority
types.boundary: Tag the digits (and any interior spaces/plus-sign) only, stopping at the following punctuation or field label — mirrors NO_PHONE_NUMBER's own boundary rule but keyed to the Faks/Fax label instead of Telefon/Tlf.

types.name: IBAN
types.definition: An International Bank Account Number for a named person or organisation's account.
include: `NO93 8601 1117 947` or solid form under a "IBAN:"/"Kontonummer (IBAN):" label
exclude: A domestic Kontonummer without IBAN formatting — still FINANCIAL_INFO, just not this specific surface form
types.boundary: Tag the full IBAN string including its country-code prefix and any group spacing.

types.name: IDENTITY_CARD
types.definition: A national identity card number issued by a public authority (politiet), per B20's issuer test.
include: `Nasjonalt ID-kort nr.: ...`
"ID-kort" value under a police-issued-document label
exclude: A private membership/library card number — excluded by B20's private-issuer test
types.boundary: Tag the value exactly as printed after the ID-card label; apply B20's issuer test rather than the label text alone.

types.name: INSURANCE_NUMBER
types.definition: An insurance policy/claim number issued by a private insurer.
include: `Forsikringsnummer: ...` / `Polisenummer: ...` / `Skadenummer: ...`
exclude: A NAV/folketrygd benefit case number issued by a public authority — that is GOV_ID under B20's issuer test, since a state agency issued it
types.boundary: Tag the number alone; per B20 a private insurer's own policy number is not government-issued and has no home in the 16-type schema (compare `medlemsnummer`/`lånenummer`, both explicitly excluded there).

types.name: IP_ADDRESS
types.definition: An IPv4 or IPv6 address tied to a named person's device or session.
include: Dotted-quad IPv4 (`192.168.1.42`)
Colon-separated IPv6
exclude: A domain name with no numeric IP (URL's own domain, also unmapped)
types.boundary: Tag the address string alone, stopping at the following punctuation or field label.

types.name: LICENSE_PLATE
types.definition: A vehicle registration number, state-assigned and GOV_ID by B20's explicit ruling.
include: `registreringsnummer DK 45778`, `reg.nr. BT 12345`
exclude: The surrounding vehicle description (make/model/colour) — stays out of the span; the plate is tagged alone, never absorbed into or extending the description (B20)
types.boundary: Tag the plate alone; never extend the span to cover the label word or the vehicle description, per B20's explicit vehicle-registration ruling.

types.name: MEDICAL_LICENSE
types.definition: A healthcare professional's authorisation/licence number issued by a public health authority (Helsedirektoratet).
include: `Autorisasjonsnummer: ...` for a doctor/nurse/veterinarian
exclude: A hospital's own internal staff ID — a private/institutional number, excluded per B20's `journalnummer`-style private-issuer test
types.boundary: Tag the value alone; B20's issuer test places a state health-authority licence in GOV_ID, alongside `Lisensnummer` (a state licence).

types.name: MILITARY_ID
types.definition: A Forsvaret (Norwegian Armed Forces) service/ID number, government-issued per B20.
include: `Militært ID-nummer: ...` / `Tjenestenummer: ...`
exclude: A private security firm's badge number — not government-issued
types.boundary: Tag the value alone; issuer test (B20) places it in GOV_ID since the Armed Forces is a public authority.

types.name: NATIONAL_ID
types.definition: Fødselsnummer or D-nummer: an 11-digit Norwegian national identity number.
include: 11 digits solid, dash-separated after digit 6, or space-separated after digit 6
D-nummer, same shape, trigger label "D-nummer"
exclude: The same 11-digit shape under a "Telefon:" label — NO_PHONE_NUMBER instead, by field-label authority
types.boundary: Tag the full 11 digits exactly as written, never splitting off the leading 6 as DATE_TIME (GOV_ID §Boundary rule).

types.name: ORG_NUMBER
types.definition: Organisasjonsnummer: a 9-digit Norwegian organisation number.
include: 9 digits solid or grouped in 3s with spaces, trigger label "Org.nr.:"
exclude: A Kontonummer of similar digit count — FINANCIAL_INFO, by field-label authority, even if shape-identical
types.boundary: Tag the full 9 digits exactly as written, including group spacing.

types.name: PASSPORT
types.definition: A passport number, issued by the police (a public authority), per B20.
include: `Passnummer: ...`
exclude: A private travel-insurance policy number referenced alongside it — INSURANCE_NUMBER's own (unmapped) domain
types.boundary: Tag the value alone; issuer test (B20) places a police-issued passport number in GOV_ID.

types.name: PASSWORD
types.definition: A credential string (password, PIN, access code) attributed to a named person.
include: A quoted password/PIN value in a security-incident narrative
exclude: A generic reference to "passordet sitt" with no literal string given — nothing verbatim to tag
types.boundary: Tag the literal credential string only, per the global verbatim rule; never paraphrase or redact it further.

types.name: PHONE
types.definition: A Norwegian telephone number under a Telefon/Tlf/Telefonnummer label.
include: 8 digits solid or grouped
With `+47` or bare `47` country-code prefix
Any digit string under a Telefon/Tlf label regardless of count, including 11-digit fødselsnummer-shaped strings
exclude: 9-digit numbers under an "Org.nr.:" label
11-digit numbers under a "Fødselsnummer:" label
types.boundary: Tag the digits (and any interior spaces/plus-sign) only, stopping at the following punctuation or field label, per NO_PHONE_NUMBER's own boundary rule.

types.name: POSTAL_CODE
types.definition: The bare 4-digit Norwegian postal code, exactly as printed.
include: 4 digits alone, including a leading zero (`0182`)
4 digits nested inside a NO_ADDRESS clause's own text
exclude: The trailing place/city name
A 4-digit year (DATE_TIME) or case-number fragment (GOV_ID)
types.boundary: Exactly 4 digits, never the place name — the one documented exception to the full-clause global rule (POSTAL_CODE's own §Boundary rule).

types.name: SOCIAL_MEDIA
types.definition: A social media handle, profile URL, or platform username tied to a named person.
include: `@handle` form
Full profile URL (`facebook.com/navn.navnesen`)
exclude: A bare platform name with no handle/URL ("har en Facebook-profil" alone) — nothing verbatim to extract
types.boundary: Tag the handle or URL string alone, stopping at trailing punctuation or whitespace.

types.name: STUDENT_ID
types.definition: A student identification number issued by an educational institution.
include: `Studentnummer: ...` at a named university/school
exclude: A national student-loan (Lånekassen) case number issued by the state — that would be GOV_ID under B20's issuer test if it appeared, since Lånekassen is a public authority; a university's own student-ID is not
types.boundary: Tag the number alone; per B20's private/institutional-issuer reasoning (parallel to `medlemsnummer`), a university-issued student ID is not a government identifier and has no home in the 16-type schema.

types.name: TAX_ID
types.definition: A taxpayer identification number issued by Skatteetaten (a public tax authority), per B20.
include: `Skatte-ID: ...` distinct from the fødselsnummer already used for tax purposes
exclude: A private accountant's own client-file number
types.boundary: Tag the value alone; issuer test (B20) places a state tax-authority ID in GOV_ID alongside fødselsnummer/org.nr.

types.name: URL
types.definition: A web address tied to a named person, organisation, or piece of evidence (e.g. a linked video/report).
include: Full `https://...` or bare `www...` string
exclude: A bare domain word used as a proper noun with no path/scheme (arguably ORGANIZATION's territory instead)
types.boundary: Tag the URL string alone, stopping at trailing punctuation or whitespace.

types.name: USERNAME
types.definition: A login/account username distinct from a full email address, tied to a named person.
include: `Brukernavn: ...` value in an account-access narrative
exclude: A full email address used as a login — that is EMAIL's own domain (maps to EMAIL_ADDRESS)
types.boundary: Tag the username string alone, stopping at trailing punctuation or the following field label.

types.name: VISA_NUMBER
types.definition: An immigration visa/residence-permit number issued by UDI (a public authority), per B20.
include: `Visumnummer: ...` / `Oppholdstillatelse nr.: ...`
exclude: A private employer's own internal work-authorisation tracking number
types.boundary: Tag the value alone; issuer test (B20) places a UDI-issued visa/permit number in GOV_ID.

types.name: ACADEMIC_RECORD
types.definition: A named person's educational credential, degree, grade, or enrolment status at a specific institution.
include: `fullført bachelorgrad i sykepleie ved OsloMet, avsluttet 2019`
A specific grade/exam result tied to a named person
exclude: A bare institution name with no credential/enrolment fact attached (LOCATION's own, unmapped, territory)
A professional licence resulting from the degree (MEDICAL_LICENSE, mapped to GOV_ID, is the separate identifier fact)
types.boundary: Tag the full descriptive clause — credential + institution + completion marker — following the same full-clause style as EMPLOYMENT_INFO's own boundary rule (B12); do not truncate to the bare degree name.

types.name: ADDRESS
types.definition: The Norwegian street-address portion of a location: street + house number, optional suffix/qualifier.
include: Street + number, with letter suffix or apartment/floor qualifier
Street + number + trailing postal code and city when all inside the same Adresse field value
exclude: A bare city/place name alone with no street
An institution/business name
The value of a standalone "Poststed:" field taken alone
types.boundary: Full clause = street + number + suffix + qualifier, and only when inside the same Adresse-field value, a trailing postal code + city, per NO_ADDRESS's own boundary rule.

types.name: AGE
types.definition: A person's or animal's age stated as a bare number of years, not embedded in a family-member clause.
include: `10 år` standing alone in prose
exclude: An age absorbed as the parenthetical of a named/counted family member (`to barn, Elias (10) og Sofia (7)`) — that stays inside the FAMILY_RELATION span instead, per B4/FAMILY_RELATION's own boundary rule
types.boundary: Tag the bare number-plus-unit only; per FAMILY_RELATION's own resolved-conflicts note, a detached age numeral is DATE_TIME, not its own type.

types.name: ANIMAL_INFO
types.definition: A bare identifying descriptor of which animal is the subject of a document (species, name, count) — not its condition.
include: `en grønn arapapegøye`
`schæferen`
A pet's proper name (`Rex`, `Balder`) used to identify which animal is meant
exclude: The animal's condition/symptom content — that is HEALTH_INFO's own animal-welfare population, not this type
A human's name that happens to resemble an animal name — PERSON, per the B21/PERSON gazetteer distinction
types.boundary: Tag the bare descriptor/name phrase identifying the animal, stopping before any condition or behavioural clause.

types.name: DATE_TIME
types.definition: Any explicit calendar date and/or clock time as printed, standalone or attached to an event/record.
include: Full timestamp, date-only dotted, prose date with month name
ISO date when standalone
Compact multi-date prose sharing one month/year as a single span
exclude: A bare year/date structurally the prefix of a GOV_ID case number or fødselsnummer
Vague relative expressions (`nylig`, `flere anledninger`)
Durations (`14 dager`)
types.boundary: Full clause = day + month + year (if printed) + clock time (if printed), stopping before deictic qualifiers and ID suffixes, per DATE_TIME's own boundary rule.

types.name: EMPLOYMENT
types.definition: A named person's occupation, job title, professional role, employer/workplace, or business ownership position.
include: Bare occupation noun for a real specific job
Coordinated ownership/management titles as one clause
A bare company/employer name when it identifies where the person works and no role word is attached
exclude: Full personal names, even with a professional honorific — PERSON owns the name
Hobby/association memberships
Political candidacy — POLITICAL_CASE's domain
types.boundary: Tag the full coordinated title including a directly-attached "av/i/ved <company>" phrase with no intervening clause break, per B12; a comma introducing new information breaks the clause.

types.name: FAMILY_RELATION
types.definition: A clause naming a family, kinship, or intimate-partnership relationship between the data subject and another individual.
include: Kinship nouns with descriptive clause
Marital/partnership status with named spouse/partner
Relationship-ending facts (skilsmisse, separasjon)
exclude: `eieren` (ownership role, not kinship)
`vold i nære relasjoner` / `besøksforbud` — CRIMINAL_RECORD
Non-kinship social ties (`nabo`, `venn`, `kollega`)
types.boundary: Span = relationship noun/phrase + any named individual + descriptive qualifier in the same clause; the named individual is additionally, separately tagged PERSON (nested), per FAMILY_RELATION's own boundary rule.

types.name: GENDER
types.definition: A person's stated biological sex or gender marker as a plain demographic field value (e.g. "Kjønn: Mann").
include: `Mann` / `Kvinne` as the value of a "Kjønn:" field
exclude: A disclosure of gender identity as a GDPR-sensitive fact (e.g. being transgender) — that routes to SEXUAL_ORIENTATION instead, per its own definition covering "gender identity"
types.boundary: Tag the bare field value only; this is the neutral demographic field, distinct from a gender-identity disclosure.

types.name: LOCATION
types.definition: A named place broader than a street address: city, region, institution, or venue.
include: Bare city/region name used to situate an event
A named institution/venue (`Bærum sykehus`) as a location reference
exclude: The street-address portion of an address (ADDRESS's own domain)
A postal code (POSTAL_CODE's own domain)
types.boundary: Tag the place/institution name alone; NO_ADDRESS's own Exclude list explicitly puts bare city names and institution names outside its scope, confirming this content has no home in the 16-type schema.

types.name: MARITAL_STATUS
types.definition: A person's marital/partnership status, with or without a named partner.
include: `gift`, `samboer`, `skilt`, `separert`
Status with named spouse/partner in the same clause
exclude: A same-sex or orientation-revealing relationship description where the orientation word is present — SEXUAL_ORIENTATION wins on those characters instead
types.boundary: Tag the status word/phrase plus any named partner in the same clause; longer form wins whenever a name directly attaches, per FAMILY_RELATION's own resolved-conflicts pattern.

types.name: NATIONALITY
types.definition: A person's stated country of citizenship or national origin.
include: `norsk statsborger`, `svensk statsborgerskap`
A stated country of origin in a biographical field
exclude: Ethnic/racial-origin content framed as identity or heritage — ETHNICITY's own (unmapped) Art. 9 territory, a categorically different fact
types.boundary: Tag the nationality adjective/phrase alone, stopping before any distinct ethnicity or immigration-status clause.

types.name: ORGANIZATION
types.definition: The name of an organisation that is a subject of the document — the entity under inspection or the workplace of a named subject.
include: The value of a "Navn på dyreeier eller virksomhet:" field
The organisation named in an "Org.nr.: NNNNNNNNN (Name)" parenthetical
exclude: A company appearing only incidentally (the reporter's own employer, a neighbour's workplace) — not tagged, per B19's own test
A bank named only as a financial counterparty — FINANCIAL_INFO's domain, not this one
types.boundary: Tag the organisation name alone when it is a subject of the document, per B19's test (the organisation's role in the document, not whether a human owner is named).

types.name: PERSON
types.definition: The full referring expression for one identifiable, named human being — given name(s) + surname, plus any directly-adjacent honorific.
include: Full name: first + last, with middle name(s)
Honorific/title directly prefixed, no comma
Single given name when context unambiguously identifies a human
exclude: Bare surname used as a family label (`Familien Eriksen`)
Animal/pet names, even proper nouns that look like personal names
Role/appositive phrases separated from the name by a comma
types.boundary: Full clause = title (if directly adjacent, no comma) + full given name(s) + surname, nothing more; stop before any comma, parenthesis, or role description, per PERSON's own boundary rule.

types.name: AGE_INFO
types.definition: A clause where a person's age is itself the sensitive fact — vulnerability due to being a minor, elderly, or age-linked capacity — beyond a bare age numeral.
include: `mindreårig og derfor særlig sårbar i saken`
A clause tying age to legal capacity or vulnerability, not just stating a number
exclude: A bare age numeral with no vulnerability/capacity framing — AGE (mapped to DATE_TIME) instead
An age absorbed as a family-member parenthetical — stays inside FAMILY_RELATION
types.boundary: Tag the full clause connecting the age to the sensitive inference, per B1 (start at the predicate, drop the bare subject) and B17 (keep a nominalised fact-bearing subject).

types.name: BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN
types.definition: A clause describing a recurring or characteristic pattern of conduct performed by an identified natural person (never an animal's own conduct).
include: Owner/subject conduct with an explicit human subject
Recurring conduct toward people or animals stated as an action of the person
Non-cooperation/evasiveness with authorities, stated as a pattern
exclude: Any span whose full subject is an animal, not the person (routes to HEALTH_INFO instead)
The reporter's/witness's own routine behaviour
Bare adjectives with no subject and no repetition marker
types.boundary: This is the one documented exception to B1: the span starts at the earliest word establishing WHO performs the pattern and keeps that subject, per B18; ends before a new independent clause.

types.name: BIOMETRIC_DATA
types.definition: A clause disclosing biometric data used or intended for unique identification of a natural person (fingerprint, facial/iris scan, voice/gait pattern used as an ID method).
include: `avga fingeravtrykk i forbindelse med...`
`identifisert ved hjelp av ansiktsgjenkjenning`
exclude: A routine physical description with no identification purpose ("høy og mørkhåret") — not biometric data in the Art. 9 sense
A photo/video reference with no unique-identification method named — IDENTIFIABLE_IMAGE's own (unmapped) territory
types.boundary: Tag the full clause naming the biometric method and its identification purpose, per B1/B2 (predicate-first, drop bare subject/determiner) and B9 (no terminal punctuation).

types.name: CONTEXT_SENSITIVE
types.definition: A residual 'other sensitive fact' clause with no positive membership test and no home in any other type.
include: Nothing — ANNOTATION_SPEC cut this type entirely for exactly this reason: it behaved as a dumping ground (3,345 presence conflicts, 338 type migrations, no keyword bucket over ~11% of its own content)
exclude: Everything the old CONTEXT_SENSITIVE type held: suspicion-of-crime phrasing (now CRIMINAL_RECORD), political/organisation affiliation (now POLITICAL_CASE), a person's own conduct (now BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN), animal disease/administrative metadata/bare org names (dropped, not tagged)
types.boundary: Do not use this type in generation; the gold-scoring legacy_map has no destination for it and any synthetic record built under it will not score against the 400-doc gold set.

types.name: CRIMINAL
types.definition: A clause naming a conviction, sentence, criminal charge, formal accusation, police report, or investigator-stated suspicion of a specific criminal offense against an identified person.
include: Convictions/sentences with trailing time qualifier
Charges/reports/accusations under active or past legal process
A bare offense noun with no accompanying accusation/conviction verb
exclude: Bare case/docket numbers and court names standing entirely alone with no accusation clause nearby
Lawful, registered possession with no illegality asserted
Bare financial amounts/state with no offense word
types.boundary: Span = [optional leading verb/noun, optional since a bare offense noun qualifies] + [offense noun phrase incl. victim] + [trailing time qualifier] + [any case/docket reference directly attached, kept inside], per CRIMINAL_RECORD's own boundary rule; nested GOV_ID on the attached case number.

types.name: DISABILITY
types.definition: A clause stating or strongly implying a physical or cognitive disability of a named person.
include: A named disability/impairment tied to a person, per HEALTH_INFO's own disability inclusion
A functional-limitation clause used as the disclosed fact (per B17, when the nominalised limitation IS the fact)
exclude: A bare accommodation/adaptation noun with no named condition ("tilrettelagt arbeidsplass" alone) — too vague to tag on its own
types.boundary: Span = [diagnostic/affliction phrase] + [condition/limitation], stopping at the first conjunction introducing a second fact, per HEALTH_INFO's own boundary rule (a); B17 keeps a fact-bearing nominalised subject.

types.name: ECONOMIC_STATUS
types.definition: A subjective, evaluative characterization of a person's or organization's overall financial condition, with no attached number, account, or named instrument.
include: Hedged hardship judgements (`sliter økonomisk`, `dårlig økonomi`)
Wealth judgements
Narrative financial-behaviour descriptions used as circumstantial evidence, without a figure
exclude: Any span containing a NOK/kr amount — FINANCIAL_INFO instead
Any span whose head word names a criminal offense — CRIMINAL_RECORD instead
Bare financial nouns with no evaluative language — FINANCIAL_INFO by the tie-break default
types.boundary: Tag the complete evaluative clause including the hedging frame up to the object of concern, plus trailing cause/effect qualifiers, per ECONOMIC_STATUS's own boundary rule; lowest precedence in the CRIMINAL_RECORD > FINANCIAL_INFO > ECONOMIC_STATUS chain.

types.name: ETHNICITY
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's racial or ethnic origin, stated neutrally in bureaucratic register.
include: A stated ethnic-origin fact in a caseworker's own descriptive register, e.g. an origin/heritage attribution tied to the data subject
exclude: A nationality/citizenship fact with no ethnic-origin framing — NATIONALITY's own (unmapped) territory, a categorically different fact
A stereotyping or derogatory characterisation — never generate this; ethnicity content must be neutral and non-stereotyping
types.boundary: Tag the full clause per B1/B2 (predicate-first, drop bare subject/determiner) and B9 (no terminal punctuation); measured at zero real instances in the current gold set (PROJECT_SPEC_V2 §1), so there is no existing boundary precedent to follow beyond the general clause rules.

types.name: FINANCIAL
types.definition: A concrete, verifiable financial fact: a specific amount, account/loan/case number, named creditor or bank, or a specific named debt instrument.
include: Any NOK/currency amount, however formatted
Named financial institutions/creditors attached to a debt or account
Specific debt/credit instruments even without a number
exclude: Pure evaluative wrappers with no attached number/named instrument — ECONOMIC_STATUS instead
Spans whose primary content is a criminal-law characterization — CRIMINAL_RECORD by precedence
types.boundary: Tag the complete quantified financial clause: amount + qualifier + creditor/debt-type phrase + itemised appositive, per FINANCIAL_INFO's own boundary rule; do not truncate to the bare number or bare noun.

types.name: GENETIC_DATA
types.definition: A clause disclosing genetic data about a named person (a DNA/genetic test result or a stated hereditary condition confirmed by genetic testing).
include: `DNA-test bekreftet farskap`
`genetisk test viste disposisjon for...`
exclude: A named diagnosis with no genetic-testing method stated — HEALTH_INFO's own domain instead
A family medical-history mention with no genetic test named ("arvelig i familien" alone, no test) — too vague, stays HEALTH_INFO if a condition is named, otherwise untagged
types.boundary: Tag the full clause naming the genetic-testing method and its result, per B1 (predicate-first) and B13 (any attached date nests as DATE_TIME).

types.name: HEALTH
types.definition: A clause stating or strongly implying a medical condition, diagnosis, disability, medication, or treatment — of a human or, in the animal-welfare threat model, of an animal whose condition evidences owner negligence.
include: Named diagnoses/disorders, diagnosis codes, medications tied to a person
Animal physical/behavioural/medical condition: pelage, weight, gait, wounds, parasites, named livestock disease
exclude: Generic behavioural description of a human with no medical content (BEHAVIORAL_PATTERN instead)
Financial/behavioural euphemisms that aren't a diagnosis (`spilleavhengighet` unless clinically framed)
types.boundary: Subcategory boundary rules per HEALTH_INFO §Boundary rule: diagnoses keep the diagnostic verb, medications keep the usage verb, symptoms keep intensifiers/body-part qualifiers, hedged conditions keep the hedge word (B1, B13, B14, B15, B22 all apply).

types.name: IDENTIFIABLE_IMAGE
types.definition: A reference to a photo, video, or recording that depicts an identifiable person's likeness.
include: Nothing with a verified genuine hit — ANNOTATION_SPEC's own targeted check for person-referencing image spans found zero genuine hits in the corpus
exclude: Generic attachment references that identify nobody (`bilder av dyrene`, `video tatt fra offentlig vei`) — the overwhelming majority of the old type's population, cut entirely per its own Removed-types verdict
types.boundary: If ever generated, tag the short noun-phrase reference to the image/recording itself (not a full narrative clause) — this is the one Tier C type whose surface form is short, matching its pre-cut examples; but default to NOT generating this type at all (see TAXONOMY_NOTES contradiction).

types.name: IMMIGRATION_STATUS
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's immigration, residence, or asylum status.
include: `har midlertidig oppholdstillatelse`
`søker om asyl`
`er statsløs`
exclude: A bare nationality/citizenship fact with no immigration-process content — NATIONALITY's own (unmapped) territory
A visa/permit reference number alone with no status statement — VISA_NUMBER (mapped to GOV_ID) instead
types.boundary: Tag the full clause per B1/B2 (predicate-first, drop bare subject/determiner) and B9 (no terminal punctuation).

types.name: MEDICATION
types.definition: A medication or treatment tied to a named person, as its own fact distinct from the diagnosis it treats.
include: `bruker antidepressiva`, `tar Metformin daglig`, `behandles med antidepressiva`
exclude: A medication named only as part of a combined diagnosis+medication clause with a distinct purpose — split per HEALTH_INFO's own rule (b): `Metformin for diabetes type 2` becomes two spans
types.boundary: Span = [usage/treatment verb] + [medication name], stopped before any trailing purpose clause naming a different fact, per HEALTH_INFO's own boundary rule (b).

types.name: POLITICAL
types.definition: A clause stating that an identified person holds, has stated, or is affiliated with a political party, movement, or opinion.
include: Membership clauses with the full verb + org name
Quoted movement/party names embedded in a membership/activity clause
Stated political opinions/positions attributed to the person
exclude: A bare organisation/party name with no attached affiliation verb
Religious affiliation with no stated political character
Local/professional roles with no ideological content
types.boundary: Span = [affiliation/opinion verb or noun] + [full name of party/movement, incl. genuine quotation marks] + [ideological descriptor if present]; never the bare proper noun alone, per POLITICAL_CASE's own boundary rule.

types.name: RELIGIOUS_BELIEF
types.definition: A clause stating or disclosing a named person's religious or philosophical belief or affiliation.
include: `medlem av Jehovas Vitner`
`tilhører Den norske kirke`
`praktiserende muslim`
A stated philosophical-belief affiliation (`Human-Etisk Forbund`)
exclude: A political-movement affiliation with a stated ideological/political (not religious) character — POLITICAL_CASE's own domain

An organisation named only in an employer-field role, per B19 (e.g. `Org.nr.: ... (Stavanger Menighetssenter)` as the employer of a named staff member) — that stays EMPLOYMENT_INFO, not this type, per B19's explicit "a congregation is treated exactly like a farm or a company" rule
types.boundary: Tag the full affiliation/belief clause including the affiliation verb and organisation/tradition name, per the same style as POLITICAL_CASE's own boundary rule (B2 determiner-drop, B9 no terminal punctuation); this is the type ANNOTATION_SPEC's Open Question 17 says the 16-type schema has no home for, despite religion appearing in 40% of the corpus (PROJECT_SPEC_V2 §1).

types.name: SEXUAL_ORIENTATION
types.definition: A clause stating, disclosing, or credibly alleging a named individual's sexual orientation, gender identity, or GDPR-Art.-9 'sex life' fact.
include: Orientation self-identifiers with immediate modifiers
Adverbial-modified form (`åpent homofil`)
Consensual-non-monogamy relationship structure
Third-party allegation/rumour about orientation (tag the substantive clause, drop the reporting frame)
exclude: Plain relationship-status nouns with no orientation word (`samboer`, `gift`) — FAMILY_RELATION instead
Extramarital-affair language with no orientation content
A stated refusal to disclose orientation — B7, nothing is revealed
types.boundary: Include leading intensifying adverbs and trailing descriptive/appositive nouns in the same noun phrase; exclude reporting verbs outside it, per SEXUAL_ORIENTATION's own boundary rule; B24 routes a minor-involving relationship to CRIMINAL_RECORD instead.

types.name: TRADE_UNION
types.definition: A clause disclosing a named person's trade union membership or organising activity.
include: `medlem av Fellesforbundet`
`tillitsvalgt i LO-forbundet ved...`
A stated organising/strike-participation fact tied to a named person
exclude: A bare case-reference number containing the letters "LO" — PROJECT_SPEC_V2 §1 found that every apparent trade-union hit in the gold set was actually a case-number artifact, not real union content; never generate a fake union hit by way of an "LO"-containing case number
A generic employer/workplace fact with no union-specific content — EMPLOYMENT_INFO instead
types.boundary: Tag the full affiliation clause including the affiliation verb and union name, per the same style as POLITICAL_CASE's own boundary rule (B2, B9); measured at zero real instances in the gold set (PROJECT_SPEC_V2 §1), so there is no existing boundary precedent beyond the general clause rules.
